description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for LDAP employee search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It contains private properties for various employee attributes and corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating LDAP employee search filtering parameters such as employee number, employee ID, emails, license numbers, and identifiers.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number if set.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID if set.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email address if set.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseNo
methods.description: Returns the driving license number if set.

methods.name: getOtherId
methods.description: Returns the other ID if set.

methods.name: getOtherEmail
methods.description: Returns the other email if set.

methods.name: getSsnNumber
methods.description: Returns the SSN number if set.

methods.name: getSinNumber
methods.description: Returns the SIN number if set.
